rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A comprehensive development environment server that provides secure access to file operations, code execution, and frontend preview capabilities. Features include Excel and CSV processing with template support, web crawling and search tools, Mermaid diagram generation, PDF and Office document handling, and sandboxed Python/Node.js execution with resource limits. Includes workspace isolation per user session via virtual path system, SSE protocol support for AI platform integration, and a web-based admin interface for monitoring.
